import importlib.util
print('z3', importlib.util.find_spec('z3'))
print('pycosat', importlib.util.find_spec('pycosat'))
print('pysat', importlib.util.find_spec('pysat'))

import z3, time
nG=5; k=3; m=27
V=[(g,i) for g in range(nG) for i in range(k)]
idx={v:p for p,v in enumerate(V)}
edges=[]
for g in range(nG):
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(i+1,k):
            edges.append((idx[(g,i)],idx[(g,j)]))
for g in range(nG-1):
    for i in range(k):
        edges.append((idx[(g,i)],idx[(g+1,i)]))
print(len(edges), edges)
X=[z3.Int(f'x_{p}') for p in range(len(V))]
D=[]
s=z3.Solver()
s.set('timeout', 55000)
for x in X: s.add(x>=0, x<=m)
s.add(z3.Distinct(X))
for e,(u,v) in enumerate(edges):
    d=z3.Int(f'd_{e}')
    D.append(d)
    s.add(d==z3.If(X[u]>=X[v], X[u]-X[v], X[v]-X[u]))
    s.add(d>=1, d<=m)
s.add(z3.Distinct(D))
# edge labels exactly 1..27 implied by distinct domain

res=s.check()
print('res',res,'time',time.time()-start)
if res==z3.sat:
